description: sflow_1d_susp_flume with van Rijn bed load (S 11 1) and bed change (S 35 1), and the sediment supply at the inflow from the time series sediment-inflow.dat (S 129 2): no supply for 50 s (the inflow cells erode), a feed of 8e-6 m^2/s bed load and C = 2e-4 from 60 to 120 s (deposition near the inflow), equilibrium after 130 s (qb, C < 0: zero gradient, C_eq).
